name: sops-age-secrets
description: MANDATORY holding standard for secrets in git: SOPS + age. OS-agnostic scripts (macOS/Linux/WSL) under scripts/: encrypt allowlisted dotenv keys → committed ciphertext; decrypt with off-repo age key → mode-600 secrets.env. ADR 0003. Self-contained — no AGENTS.md reinforcement required after APM install.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Whenever a holding project needs secrets available on more than one machine, or an agent would otherwise commit or invent a secrets path: follow this skill. Encrypt via allowlist → secrets.enc.yaml; decrypt via age.key → secrets.env. Never commit age.key or plaintext env.
usage.engineers: SOPS+age encrypt/decrypt workflow for holding repositories. Canonical scripts live under dev-host/scripts until extracted.
usage.founders: The only approved way to put secrets in git for multi-machine use across the holding (ADR 0003).
